decision_reason: Twenty-one ONT UMI groups and three exact 222-nt Q20 reads phase the alleles, but no target epitope passes the configured class-I filters.
dna_only: Two variants 6,181 bp apart cannot be assigned to one expressed molecule from independent DNA calls or site-local short reads.
interpretation: Long reads change the protein claim by linking two substitutions 207 coding nucleotides apart. Vaxrank retains the negative epitope result without forcing selection.
limitation: No 25-mer spans both amino-acid changes; long reads prove molecular phase, while each local antigen remains independently targetable.
osteosarc_sequence_status: The page annotates p.Arg1310Met but does not publish a protein sequence context.
